answer: Because the timing is recorded against the vault challenge, the meadow audit can replay the sparrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 291 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1261 identities would post 3788 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
